messages:
Juniper: Quick FYI — onboarding sampleapp failing on rerank. We saw an embedding shape mismatch.
Alex: Minimal repro?
Juniper: Go batcher sent header X-Embedding-Length: 1024, python payload set "dim":1023. Server returned 400 "length mismatch".
Priya: Any auth retries while this happened?
Juniper: Yes — 401 -> refresh -> retry in logs. Might be a reslice that changed length after header was stamped.
Alex: Hmm. Short-term: drop header in Go or set it after serialization; server should canonicalize using len(values).
Priya: Also add explicit error: "declared dim X != actual len Y" so DX is clearer.
sdk-bot: Created INF-4310: "canonicalize embedding length; ignore header, validate against payload" and tagged go/python SDKs.
dev-bot: Canary pipeline updated to include shape-validator middleware.
Juniper: Patch incoming to sampleapp to stop sending header and add unit that serializes then computes header from actual length.
Alex: I'll open a tiny server PR to canonicalize and improve the error message. Priya: add E2E in devex harness to run both sampleapps together.
Priya: Also audit retry path so we don't mutate enqueued buffers after the request object is built. Make copies or use immutables.
Juniper: Thanks — will post PR links here once ready.
